top 5 products by revenue in chattogram.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(v.revenue_bdt)) AS revenue_bdt FROM v_sales v JOIN products p ON p.id=v.product_id JOIN distributors d ON d.id=v.distributor_id JOIN divisions dv ON dv.id=d.division_id WHERE dv.name_en='Chattogram' AND v.day BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

which division had the highest sales thi.sql: SELECT dv.name_en AS division, ROUND(SUM(v.revenue_bdt)) AS revenue_bdt FROM v_sales v JOIN distributors d ON d.id=v.distributor_id JOIN divisions dv ON dv.id=d.division_id WHERE v.day BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-22' GROUP BY dv.id ORDER BY revenue_bdt DESC LIMIT 1

show weekly revenue trend for the last 1.answer_text: Weekly revenue in the last 12 weeks: from ৳ 1.11 crore to ৳ 1.04 crore (-6% first to last week).
show weekly revenue trend for the last 1.sql:
SELECT date(v.day, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS week, ROUND(SUM(v.revenue_bdt)) AS revenue_bdt
FROM v_sales v
JOIN distributors d ON d.id = v.distributor_id
JOIN divisions dv ON dv.id = d.division_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = v.product_id
WHERE v.day BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-11-22'

চট্টগ্রামে শীর্ষ 5টি পণ্য কোনগুলো.answer_text: শীর্ষে জয়া স্যানিটারি ন্যাপকিন রেগুলার (৳ ৬.৩ লাখ); এরপর ওরস্যালাইন-এন (৳ ৬.১ লাখ), স্মাইল বেবি ডায়াপার এম (৳ ৪.৯ লাখ)।
চট্টগ্রামে শীর্ষ 5টি পণ্য কোনগুলো.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(v.revenue_bdt)) AS revenue_bdt FROM v_sales v JOIN products p ON p.id=v.product_id JOIN distributors d ON d.id=v.distributor_id JOIN divisions dv ON dv.id=d.division_id WHERE dv.name_en='Chattogram' AND v.day BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

কোন ডিস্ট্রিবিউটরদের বকেয়া সবচেয়ে বেশি.answer_text: সবচেয়ে বেশি বকেয়া Dhaka Distributor 03 (DHK-03)-এর: ৳ ১৬.০ লাখ (মেয়াদোত্তীর্ণ ৳ ৮১,০০০)।
কোন ডিস্ট্রিবিউটরদের বকেয়া সবচেয়ে বেশি.sql:
SELECT d.code, d.name AS distributor, dv.name_en AS division, r.outstanding_bdt, r.overdue_bdt,
       ROUND(100.0 * r.outstanding_bdt / d.credit_limit_bdt, 1) AS pct_of_limit
FROM receivables r
JOIN distributors d ON d.id = r.distributor_id
JOIN divisions dv ON dv.id = d.division_id

ORDER BY r.outstanding_bdt DESC
LIMIT 5
